prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Redesign the attached 8x social video grid concept into a much more refined, memorable continuous VIDEO TAPESTRY with a shared travelling spotlight and halftone dissolution. Make one high resolution 1536x1280 visual proposal board: a large realistic desktop website section above, three small motion states beneath. Input image is the previous concept for brand context and source footage appearance only. Retain warm stone, black type, serif8x logo, tiny vermilion accent. Substantially change the media art direction.

MAIN WEBSITE (upper80%):
Calm flat warm stone #e9e5dc throughout, no panel backgrounds, no scene boundary. Quiet nav, serif '8x' small 'social' at left, right 'The network', 'How it works', 'For creators', 'Let’s talk ↗'. Strong high-end graphic typography below, two-line heading 'Many voices.' / 'One network.' at left, ample whitespace around it. Heading not oversized. To right: 'Creators, content and publishing. One team behind it all.' with small vermilion 'Build your network ↗' below. Extremely disciplined proportions and spacing.

The visual is an expansive WIDE equal-cell grid of EIGHTEEN portrait creator-video clips, 9columns x2rows, filling almost the entire width below heading. This is perceived as ONE cinematic living surface, NOT18 separate cards. Equal9:16 cells, aligned baseline, very tight4-6px dark gaps, no rounded corners, no frames, no dropshadows, no phonebezels, no labels or controls. Include varied creator subjects from reference, real-life demos, people speaking, musician, unboxing, desk scenes. Retain authentic phone-footage texture and believable faces, not glossy model headshots. Source subjects from reference recur only when clearly different shots; avoid obvious duplicates. Supplemental faces are illustrative placeholders. No invented testimonials, textclaims, data or logos.

Crucial material treatment: The LEFT and RIGHTmost 20% of the entire mosaic and a narrow strip along its bottom physically dissolve through tiny halftone dots into the surrounding stone page. These clips remain faintly readable as ghosted dot portraits in stone, with centerclips sharp. The grid has NO HARD OUTER RECTANGULAR EDGE. It should feel like images emerging from ink dots printed directly into the page, sophisticated crisp print/digital contrast. NOT a big row of white-bordered video cards. No separate dotted border or polka-dot wallpaper. Dot pattern becomes the media itself at perimeter, fading elegantly to zero.

Crucial LIGHT treatment: Most clips are tasteful muted graphite-monochrome, sufficiently bright to see faces andcontent. Only a broad soft oval region spanning3neighboring central clips is currently in rich NATURAL COLOUR. A large, feathered warm-white/apricot light pool moves across the common surface and restores natural color where it passes. It is clearly one shared light, not borders lit individually. Extremely subtle warm luminous spill in the hairline gaps and dots at its edges. Highlights must remain photographic, not washedout yellow. No neonoutlinedcards, no glowingrectangles, no orangebeamstripes, no lasers, no sci-fi effects. One woman in center, musician adjacent and a phone demo on lowerrow are lit naturally. Other video faces are grayscale and delicately shaded. Make main screenshot clearly display this selective-colour focus effect, NOT all clips fullycoloured. This is the key difference from input.

The mosaic feels like an atmospheric editorial installation that can respond to your hand: rich but minimal, confident and human. Geometry stays still. A subtle silk-smooth light pass creates depth through focus/colour alone. No3Dtilt or warpedcards.
Belowmedia one low-key line 'Find your people. Keep content moving. See what works.' and at right 'TikTok · Instagram · YouTube Shorts'. All content visible, generousstone margins.

STORYBOARD (bottom20%, separated only withwhitespace):
Three small identical copies of the SAME18clip tapestry showing different spotlight positions. Small labels '01 / ARRIVE', '02 / A SHARED CURRENT', '03 / RESPOND'. First has soft colourlight nearleft, middle atcenter, final at right with one discretecursor. Clearly show light moving while grid positions andhalftoneperimeter remain identical. Noall-colour variants. Tiny caption at bottom 'One surface. A slow light pass. Colour follows your touch.' The storyboard is presentation annotation outside the proposed website; no diagram arrows on actual website.

Avoid standard dashboard/card-grid appearance. Avoid loud decorative effects. Aim for outstanding luxury-editorial website craft, minimal and ambitious, integrated stone page, monochrome photography with just a local living pool ofcolour, crisp fine halftone material, generous breathingroom. Entire composition fits, no cut-off text.
